point_rule: Weighted conditional median under the declared observed-grade cost, then child<=parent cap. Tail-cost decisions are not population median estimates.
point_selection: On inner OOF only, select feasible candidate maximizing the mean of raw grade5 and grade6 exact recalls; tie-break by raw MAE and fixed candidate order. If none feasible, fall back to R2 extra_trees median and record infeasibility.
point_outer_qualification: All point limits must hold on the selected outer workflow, and the upper 95% paired beer-bootstrap raw-MAE increase bound must be <=0.02. Otherwise do not replace the R2 median point predictor.
calibration: For each target select prior/extra_trees/raw_ordinal by inner uncalibrated nonzero-rating Brier score, prior wins ties. Fit six monotone sigmoid recalibrators to the chosen inner OOF cumulative probabilities, then project them to decreasing order. Prior-selected targets retain the outer-training prior. Never fit calibration on outer-test labels or select sources using in-sample calibrated scores.
risk_meaning: Chance that a taster rating is >=k under equal-taster/equal-presentation weighting; not the chance of exceeding a chemical threshold or proof of safety.
risk_status_rule: Compare calibrated nonzero Brier to training-only prior. Mark descriptive support only if the 99% fixed-loss paired beer-bootstrap improvement lower bound is positive; otherwise insufficient_heldout_support. Never certify safety.
evaluation_scope: Post-R2 development on the same 250 beers, 3 outer / 2 inner beer-grouped folds. No new external test set, no new chemical units or acetaldehyde labels, no R3 or Q3 optimization.
